description: Get up to 9 gift ideas for someone's hobby, pitched at their skill level (just curious, getting into it, obsessed), within the budget and skipping what they already own, plus a giftgenius.io link that opens the same ideas with photos and where to buy them. Also returns what someone at that level probably owns already. Pass what you know they own; the more specific, the better.

age.description: Recipient age in years, if known.

budget.description: Price per gift: under-25, 25-50, 50-100, or 100-plus. Ideas come from this tier or cheaper.

hobby.description: The hobby, as specific as you know it, e.g. "home espresso", "pickleball", "watercolor painting".

level.description: How into it they are: "curious" (just trying it), "getting-into-it" (has the basics, practicing regularly) or "obsessed" (deep into it, owns good gear).

owns.description: What they already own for this hobby, brands and models if known (max 300 characters). Ideas skip these.

relationship.description: Who the gift is for, if known. Map husband/wife/boyfriend/girlfriend to "Partner", son/daughter to "Kid", brother/sister to "Sibling", grandma/grandpa to "Grandparent", colleague to "Coworker"; otherwise "Someone else".

name: find_hobby_gifts

already_owns.description: What someone at this level likely already has (plus what was passed in "owns"): skip these.

finder_url.description: A search for this hobby on giftgenius.io, for the user to refine or get more ideas.

on_sale.description: True when the Amazon product matched to this idea had a deal open to every shopper when this answer was made. Its price and deal are on list_url.

why.description: Why this recipient will love it, addressed to the giver.

list_url.description: These same ideas on giftgenius.io, with photos and where to buy each one.

note.description: An insider tip for the giver.

page_url.description: Gift Genius hobby page for this hobby, when there is one.

title: Find gifts for a hobbyist
